name: (01) Serpentis — 1 Basic — The Eyes of the Serpent

system.description:
Your eyes turn gold with vast black irises, and the legendary hypnotic gaze of the serpent captures whoever meets them.

Make a Social Challenge (retest Subterfuge) against a target who need only be able to see your eyes. On success he is completely immobilized for as long as you hold his gaze with your own. The hypnotic spell breaks the instant the target is attacked or injured.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: As long as gaze is held
